A collection of 1,381 character sprites from all three Loca-Love games.
The sprites were assembled from the original game layers and saved as transparent PNGs at the highest available resolution for each variant. The collection includes alternate outfits, poses, and facial expressions. Pixel-identical sprites shared across the games are included only once.

收录了来自全部三部《Loca-Love》游戏的1,381个角色立绘图。
这些立绘是从原版游戏的各个图层中拼装而成，并以每个变体可用的最高分辨率保存为透明PNG。
该合集包含替换服装、姿势和面部表情。跨游戏完全像素一致的立绘仅收录一次。

这部作品的解密也是恶心到我了，混合xor和cxdec加密
